basic_info.description: Step into a rare opportunity in one of 101 Lombard's most coveted 3 bedroom floor plans. This southeast-facing, three-bedroom corner condo offers sweeping, iconic views of the Bay, the Bridge, and the City, perfect for sophisticated buyers looking for good space, views and easy lifestyle.  Each bedroom overlooks the serene beauty of Telegraph Hill's treetops, with two of the three bedrooms featuring charming balconies. The spacious living room, anchored by a cozy wood-burning fireplace, opens to a huge deckideal for soaking in the views of the Bay, Coit Tower, and Julius' Castlecomplete with a large storage closet next to the unit for all your other stuff.  Enjoy meals in a formal dining area framed by a bay window that floods the space with light, creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Added conveniences like deeded parking, a 24-hour doorperson, and fantastic amenities, including a lap pool and hot tub, make this home a blend of luxury and ease.  With its perfect location and rare combination of features, this condo offers an incredible opportunity to experience the best of San Francisco living. Don't miss your chance to call it home!
